note: site header chrome -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user links (Donate/Log in/Create account)
table of contents -- renders: Contents, Unpin, and section headings (Description, History, Algorithms, etc.)
page title bar -- renders: article title, language selector
article namespace tabs -- renders: Article, Talk
article view tabs and tools -- renders: Read, Edit, View history, Tools
appearance settings -- renders: Appearance, Unpin, Font (Small/Standard/Large), Width (Standard/Wide), Color (Auto/Light/Dark)
site subtitle -- renders: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
site footer -- renders: last modified timestamp, rendered with MediaWiki, copyright, Privacy policy, About, Disclaimers, Contact, Mobile view
